title: Gravity and Orbit
author: C. M. Brightwater
blurb: Tamsin Crane, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
